title: English Practice Quiz 0919
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A spreadsheet formula usually begins with ___.
questions.explanation: an equals sign is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A PDF is commonly used to ___.
options: share documents while preserving their layout
questions.explanation: share documents while preserving their layout is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Cloud storage allows files to be ___.
questions.explanation: stored on remote internet-connected servers is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A backup is a separate copy made to ___.
options: help recover data if the original is lost
questions.explanation: help recover data if the original is lost is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A file extension usually indicates ___.
questions.explanation: the file type or format is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A strong search query uses ___.
options: specific words related to the information needed
questions.explanation: specific words related to the information needed is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A read-only file permission generally allows users to ___.
questions.explanation: view content without editing it is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Version history can help users ___.
options: review or restore earlier document changes
questions.explanation: review or restore earlier document changes is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A browser cache stores ___.
options: temporary website data to help pages load
questions.explanation: temporary website data to help pages load is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before sharing a work document externally, check ___.
questions.explanation: permissions and confidential content is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
